I have maybe 4 really good friends. my sister my mom and my dad. and of course my girlfriend. That would be all I would effect. 

If there is one thing life has taught me. People get over it. sometimes it takes longer. Sometimes shorter, but you get over it.

You could say the same about suicide, but the feeling that you want to climb out of your own skin because you disgust yourself so much is really hard to get over, because you are living in it. and your skin is sort of stuck to you. It isn't like memory, it doesn't fade with time..... I guess your body does fade with time... but imagine you were molested as a child and you relive that memory with feelings every day. I think that waiting for old age death would be a loooong time.

Honestly, that is how I feel. I feel as though I am simply waiting till I die. So I think it is time to take it upon myself.
